# Design & UI Resources

A curated list of design resources, tools, and inspiration for UI/UX designers.

## Color & Inspiration
- **Dribbble** - Design inspiration and community. https://dribbble.com/
- **Coolors** - Color palette generator. https://coolors.co/
- **Awwwards** - Website design awards and inspiration.

## Typography
- **Google Fonts** - Free, open-source fonts for web and print. https://fonts.google.com/
- **Font Squirrel** - Free fonts for commercial use. https://www.fontsquirrel.com/
- **Typewolf** - Typography inspiration and resources.

## Icons & Graphics
- **Heroicons** - Free, open-source SVG icons. https://heroicons.com/
- **Unsplash** - Free high-resolution stock photos. https://unsplash.com/
- **Feather Icons** - Simple, open-source icons.
- **Lucide** - Community-driven fork of Feather Icons. https://lucide.dev/
